name: GenieX Manager
description: Manages the geniex serve process and on-device model downloads for the GenieX provider

serve.description: How the gateway manages the `geniex serve` process.

mode.description: auto (default): reuse an instance already listening on the host, otherwise start one. always: always start our own. never: leave the process to the operator.

host.description: Bind address for the managed server (default 127.0.0.1:18181).

compute.description: Default compute unit for requests that do not specify one. Per-model settings on the geniex provider plugin override this.

keepAliveSeconds.description: Idle seconds before GenieX unloads the cached model.
